nom: Filorga Time-Filler Shot, A Moisturizing Serum with Neuropeptide Technology & Polysaccharides to Relax Expression Lines, Hydrate, & Firm Skin for Visible Results in 7 Days, 0.5 fl. Oz.

avis.texte: I bought this to compare to my Revision Revox Line Relaxer (which is the holy grail of line relaxers, but very pricy). I’ll start by saying it is VERY scented. If you’re sensitive to smells, you probably won’t like it. The smell is very perfumey. The formula is good quality and goes on nicely. I didn’t notice results like I expected, however. Between that and the scent, I just wasn’t impressed.

I really wanted to like this and give it a try but then I found out it has added fragrances so I had to return it because I get bad headaches from fragrances. I wish they would make one that’s fragrance free !!
I was pretty skeptical when I bought this but it actually works. You can feel it immediately ... feels so good and you see the difference. Try it!
This serum gives an instant glow. Feel skin tightening after use. Suitable for daytime for a fresh look.
A bit expensive but definitely makes a difference in wrinkles. Noticed a difference within the first week of using.

I have been using this for about 2 weeks now, and I am finally starting to see an improvement in my skin. It's not a huge change, but the change is enough to make a difference. At age 68, I don't expect miracles, but fine lines and small wrinkles are softening and filling in. I use this serum twice a day, morning and evening. The dispenser makes it simple to apply and prevents waste. I have mildly sensitive skin and have not experienced any irritation. It is not drying my skin, but I also use lots of moisturizers and hyaluronic acid serums. I have no problem applying other serums, moisturizers, or makeup over it. I have noticed the biggest change in the fine lines above my lip and the crow's feet at the corners of my eyes. The lines are still there, just softer and less noticeable.

I’m so self-conscious about my forehead creases but Botox isn’t in the budget at the moment. I was excited to try this time filler shot to really target this area. The applicator is fun to use, I like the pump. I wish the product came out just slightly slower. After committing to usinh this day and night, I am starting to see results as my skin looks fuller. I was worried about this conflicting with any of my current skincare ingredients. You know how you’re not supposed to mix certain products to ensure efficacy? I wasn’t sure how to best navigate this but only had an issue with one of my concentrated serum capsules–that made the products pill on my face. But everything else I used, from serums to moisturizers to makeup worked great.

Overall, I think this is a good product but the whole special applicator is a bit much and not necessarily worth the price. I think this is just primarily a hyaluronic acid serum - a great skincare ingredient that is relatively inexpensive. What you're paying for here is the little wand-like applicator to massage it into your skin, and on that I'm a little "meh." It seems like a lot of non-recyclable packaging to do something that my fingers can do just as well. I don't know. I'm getting a little more conscientious about stuff like this in our ever-garbaging world, so unless the application is like WOW, I question its usefulness. Also, the fragrance is pleasant, but pretty strong. I definitely would prefer if it was unfragranced, since it's a product I'm putting on my face. I've only been using this a week and haven't noticed any changes, but after I finish up the tube, I'll update my review. It would really have to wow me at this price when I can get something as effective (sans fancy applicator) from elsewhere at 1/4 the price.

With all the languages on the box I assumed it was in the EU and Spain definitely makes that true. Though it says Paris on the name and there's a UK company involved so maybe it's just a UK company. I have no idea. The applicator is simple to use and spread on fine lines and wrinkles. It feels nice to use and if it's true that it's 60% active ingredients then that would be fantastic.

I think this filler has great ingredients to help soften our expression lines on our face. It dispenses well with just a little at a time. I target the lines and creases on my face with this serum and applicator. Then I rub in any excess well. Have used it for a week now, and I do feel it is helping. Will continue to use and hope for even more noticeable results. Great product!
